summary: The fractal-runtime test inherited_outer_procfs_refuses_launch_and_control_before_mutation skips, with one loud line, on a dev box that forbids unprivileged user namespaces (Ubuntu's AppArmor restriction), and only outside CI. st-test records each such skip as the note input env_skips (evidence-wrap --input-file, and per crate for rust-tests), so the evidence says which tests did not run on that machine. CI still runs the test.

replay.detail: Test and evidence tooling only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change. Evidence notes gain one extra input, env_skips, which the signer records as it records other extra inputs.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change. st-test passes --input-file only to an evidence-wrap that has it, so a base without this change still signs.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

manual.detail: No operator action. Granting unprivileged user namespaces to unshare on the dev box (an AppArmor profile) removes the skip there.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; the test then fails again on a dev box without unprivileged user namespaces.
